dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (III)
dialogues.text: Almost a full circuit of the city, without even realizing it. Hope you're not feeling too tired...

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (III)
dialogues.text: This next treasure hunt will test your understanding of <color=#00E2FFFF>graffiti patterns</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (III)
dialogues.text: I trust that shouldn't be a problem for you!
